drills.stem: Ungrounded conductors are upsized from #12 to #8 Cu for voltage drop on a 20A circuit. What must you do for the EGC?
choices: Increase the EGC proportionally per 250.122(B) using Chapter 9 Table 8
Always jump to the same size as the ungrounded conductor
The EGC is never increased for voltage drop
hintLadder: Primary noun: equipment grounding conductor + the trigger phrase 'increased in size'
Cite: 250.122(B). The increase is a circular-mils ratio from Chapter 9 Table 8. Read your book

drills.stem: Does 250.122(B) trigger only when the ungrounded conductors were upsized for voltage drop, or for any reason?
choices: For any increase in ungrounded conductor size, regardless of the reason
Only when the upsize is two trade sizes or more
hintLadder: Primary noun: the TRIGGER is the size increase itself, not the reason for it
Cite: 250.122(B). Read the trigger wording in your book

drills.stem: After you compute the proportional EGC increase under 250.122(B), how do you land on a real conductor size?
choices: Round DOWN to the previous standard size
Round UP to the next standard EGC size per Table 250.122 / 250.122(B)
Use the exact computed circular-mil area with no rounding
Drop back to the base Table 250.122 size
hintLadder: Primary noun: rounding rule after the proportional calculation
Cite: 250.122(B). Read the exact rounding language in your book before you commit
